name: Home Assistant — Camera
description: Snapshot from one or more Home Assistant camera.* entities. Pulls each entity's entity_picture via HA's REST API and renders it as a still frame — perfect for a door cam, garden cam, or 2×2 grid of indoor cameras on an e-ink display.

cell_options.name: full_bleed
cell_options.label: Full-bleed frame
cell_options.help: Drop the title bar + padding and let the camera image fill the entire cell edge-to-edge. The camera name + state overlay sits at the bottom on a faint gradient so it stays legible.
